title: Coupled two-DOF modal step response against continuous and scheme-exact references
source: Chopra, Dynamics of Structures, 5th ed., §9.4; coupled K=[[8,-4],[-4,4]], M=I modal superposition, with an independent average-acceleration discrete-frequency evaluation for the second reference.

quantities.quantity: mass 1 displacement at t=0.5 s, continuous modal reference
quantities.reason: The coupled chain is expanded in both exact modes; the continuous step response is the sum of (1-cos(omega t))/omega^2 terms. The 1e-5 relative allowance follows the largest fixed-step modal phase error over the 2 s record (the observed difference is 5e-8 to 2.5e-7).

quantities.quantity: mass 2 displacement at t=0.5 s, continuous modal reference
quantities.reason: The coupled chain is expanded in both exact modes; the continuous step response is the sum of (1-cos(omega t))/omega^2 terms. The 1e-5 relative allowance follows the largest fixed-step modal phase error over the 2 s record (the observed difference is 5e-8 to 2.5e-7).

quantities.quantity: mass 1 displacement at t=0.5 s, scheme-exact modal reference
quantities.reason: The same two modal terms are evaluated with omega_tilde=(2/dt) atan(omega dt/2), the exact phase of average acceleration for this dt; 1e-12 checks the implementation against the independent discrete formula.
